note: Round 24 shadow tint. Shade is blue-violet, not grey: a sky-lit fill on every lit surface that is out of the sun, the same fill in the baked terrain shadow, a cool tint on AO creases, and a post split-tone that lifts and cools only the dark end. ?shadowtint=off restores round 23. fill = linear radiance multiplied by the surface albedo; sunLo/sunHi = how much direct light (relative to albedo) counts as 'in sun'.
